_doc: Post-creation validation — verifies nodes exist and match expected properties. Run after any creation operation to confirm success. Pairs with cleanup-orphans.json for recovery.
_usage: Replace {{NODE_IDS}} and {{EXPECTATIONS}} with your creation results. Send each validation query.

validations._expect: Collection returned with expected variable count
Base64 PNG data for visual comparison

design_system: Each collection has expected mode count
Variable counts meet minimums (Primitive: 50+, Semantic: 10+, Tokens: 15+, Theme: 10+)
Alias chains resolve correctly (Theme → Token → Semantic → Primitive)
component: Component exists and has correct type (COMPONENT or COMPONENT_SET)
All variants present with correct naming (prop=value format)
Variables bound to fills, strokes, text
Component properties defined and linked to children
layout: Padding and spacing values match spec
